Below is a short description of what’s happening, followed by two small Prism-config patches that add PlantUML support:

1) Bug scenario & root cause  
   • You’ve tried to use Prism to highlight PlantUML/PUML/WSD files, but nothing happens.  
   • Prism’s “languages” table never had a `plantuml` entry, and your build (gulpfile) never included `prism-plantuml.js`.  

2) Fix outline  
   • In `components.js`, insert a `"plantuml"` entry into the `languages` dictionary.  
   • In `gulpfile.js/paths.js`, add `'components/prism-plantuml.js'` into the `main` bundle list.

3) Patches  

```javascript
### components.js
<<<<<<< SEARCH
    "yaml":{"title":"YAML","alias":"yml","owner":"hason"},
    "yang":{"title":"YANG","owner":"RunDevelopment"}
},"plugins":{
=======
    "yaml":{"title":"YAML","alias":"yml","owner":"hason"},
    "yang":{"title":"YANG","owner":"RunDevelopment"},
    "plantuml":{
        "title":"PlantUML",
        "alias":["puml","wsd"],
        "require":"markup",
        "owner":"prism-community"
    }
},"plugins":{
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

```javascript
### gulpfile.js/paths.js
<<<<<<< SEARCH
            'components/prism-javascript.js',
            'plugins/file-highlight/prism-file-highlight.js'
=======
            'components/prism-javascript.js',
            'components/prism-plantuml.js',
            'plugins/file-highlight/prism-file-highlight.js'
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

With those two edits in place, rebuild your Prism bundle and it will recognize and highlight PlantUML (`.puml`/`.wsd`) files.
